users.needRead: You need user.read to view accounts.
users.title: Users
users.description: Active accounts. Find an account by subject to inspect or reactivate it.
users.subject: Account subject
users.deleteDescription: This anonymizes the account and permanently deletes its personal workspace and credentials. Shared content remains. This cannot be undone.
users.activateDescription: The user can access PaperGo with their assigned scopes and permissions.

groups.needRead: You need group.read to view groups.
groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Give access to people together. Groups can contain other groups.
groups.managedByProvider: Membership is managed by your identity provider.
groups.deleteDescription: Members lose the access granted through this group.

inbox.label: Shared inbox
inbox.hint: Changing the inbox requires manage access to both the current and destination libraries.

roles.needRead: You need role.read to view roles.
roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What people may do across the organization. Workspace and collection access is managed separately.
roles.deleteDescription: Everyone assigned this role loses its scopes.
roles.builtInHint: Built-in role scopes and metadata are read-only. Assign people and groups from the role list.

audit.needRead: You need audit.read to view the audit log.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Who changed what and when, newest first.

maintenance.needManage: You need organization.manage to export or import the organization.
maintenance.title: Export and import
maintenance.description: Copy a workspace to another PaperGo instance, with its configuration and optional content. Organization packages transfer the whole instance.
maintenance.includeContentHint: Include items, folders, history and all file versions. Clear this to copy configuration only.
maintenance.importHint: Workspace packages create a new workspace alongside existing ones. Organization packages require an instance without resources. Try it first to validate without making changes.
maintenance.workspaceName: New workspace name (optional, workspace packages only)
maintenance.workspaceNamePlaceholder: Use the name from the package

package.description: Export a package or import one to add its definitions.

operation.dryRun: Validation only; content was not imported.

tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.description: Create scoped credentials for integrations. Each integration gets its own service identity. Grant that identity access to the workspaces it needs.
tokens.newDescription: The secret is shown once. Scopes limit operations; workspace permissions still apply. Select workspace.manage only when the integration needs organization-wide content access.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.saveDescription: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
tokens.revokeDescription: This credential stops authenticating immediately, including queued work that revalidates it.

problem.url: Use a host name without a scheme, port or path, such as docs.example.com.
problem.ip: IP addresses can't be listed; use a host name, or * to trust every public host.
problem.wildcard: A wildcard is * on its own, or starts the entry, as in *.example.com.
problem.full: Use a full host name, such as docs.example.com.
problem.invalid: {{name}} is not a valid host name.

trustedHosts.reloaded: Someone else changed the list. It has been reloaded; try again.
trustedHosts.title: Trusted hosts
trustedHosts.description: PaperGo shows and fetches content from these hosts without asking. Links to other hosts ask before they open, their images wait to be shown, and integrations and connections can't reach them.
trustedHosts.wildcardWarning: * trusts every public host. Add the hosts your organization uses, then remove * to trust only those.
trustedHosts.empty: No host is trusted. Every link asks first, no remote image loads, and integrations and connections can't reach the internet.
trustedHosts.subdomains: Trusts every subdomain of {{host}}, but not {{host}} itself.
trustedHosts.appliesTo: Applies to images and links in Markdown, links in PDFs, URL fields, calendar integrations and connections to public addresses. Server-side fetches reach public addresses only over TLS; private networks only when the operator lists them in connections.networks.
trustedHosts.stopDescription: {{uses}} will stop working: integrations stop refreshing and show “Host no longer trusted”, and connections stop connecting. Their items stay, and they resume when the host is trusted again.

relationshipTypes.needRead: You need item.read and taxonomy.read to view relationship types.
relationshipTypes.title: Relationship types
relationshipTypes.description: Labels belong to the term store. Direction, limits and attributes stay fixed once created.
relationshipTypes.createDescription: Types use the shared term store. Direction and limits stay fixed once created.
relationshipTypes.definitionsHint: Optional scalar fields. Each definition has key, label, type and optional required, choices, scale and options. Reference fields, indexing and unique values are unsupported.

terms.needRead: You need taxonomy.read to view the term store.
terms.open: People can add terms when assigning metadata.
terms.chooseDescription: Shared keywords and categories for managed metadata and free keywords.
terms.deleteDescription: The server checks that no fields or terms still reference this definition.
terms.allowAdd: Allow people to add terms when assigning metadata
terms.parentPlaceholder: Parent term id, empty for root
terms.csvDescription: SharePoint term-set format: Term Set Name, Term Set Description, LCID, Available for Tagging, Term Description and Level 1 Term through Level 7 Term.

field.columnDescription: Columns are shared organization fields. Editing one updates every list and library that uses it.
field.fieldDescription: Organization fields are shared. Editing a field updates every collection using it.
field.keyHint: Used by the API, filters and workflows. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
field.currencyHint: Starts with the workspace default, or the organization default when no override is set.
field.termSetHint: Choose the term set that defines this taxonomy field.
field.indexed: Use for filtering, sorting and grouping in views
field.indexedAlways: Use for filtering, sorting and grouping in views (always on for keywords and parent terms)
field.applyParents: Apply parent terms (picking a term also tags its parents)
field.fixed: Saved keys, types and decimal scales cannot be changed.

contentTypes.needRead: You need contentType.read to view this catalog.
contentTypes.title: Content types
contentTypes.description: Reusable schemas shared by collections. A type inherits every field and rule of the type it derives from; lists customize their own copy.
contentTypes.fieldCatalogDescription: Editing or deleting a field changes every content type and collection that uses it.
contentTypes.deleteDescription: Only a type without subtypes that no list or library uses, now or in its items' history, can be deleted. Workflow rules and smart folders that name it stop matching.
contentTypes.formLayoutHint: The order forms show the fields in, and whether this type requires each and its default. Fields themselves stay as they are for other types.
contentTypes.typeDescription: Changes apply to every type deriving from this one and to every list using them.
contentTypes.customizeDescription: Only this list changes. Everything {{type}} defines stays, and stays in step with the catalog.
contentTypes.removeColumnDescription: This removes the column from this collection, with its current values; other lists keep it. Earlier versions keep theirs. A column a catalog content type provides stays: hide it in the content type instead.
contentTypes.deleteFieldDescription: This removes the shared field from every content type, list and library that uses it, with its current values. Earlier versions keep theirs.
contentTypes.columnsDescription: The information kept for each item. Columns are shared fields: editing one changes it everywhere it is used, removing one removes it from this collection only.
contentTypes.noCustomFields: No custom fields defined. System properties are available on every item.
contentTypes.listDescription: Kinds of items this list holds. Each comes from the catalog with its columns; customizing one changes it for this list only. New items use the default type; the New menu offers the checked types in this order.
contentTypes.detachDescription: The content type stays available to other lists, and this list keeps its customizations if you add it again. A type still used by items cannot be removed.
